method: Separate mixed-benchmark sensitivity: retain <=5-minute completed CEX candles; fill missing known assets using Aave oracle at previous block, provider address verified each requested block, BASE_CURRENCY_UNIT=1e8 checked endpoints. Aave valuation may use caps/redemption ratios/stale feeds and is not an executable market quote; feed update timestamps not audited. Do not replace primary market-only results or label exact profit.
